meta.description: Knowledge graph for the robosuite Wipe task: a UR5e with a 0-DOF wiping pad presses down and sweeps along a trail of dirt markers on the table until all are cleared. The dirt is a randomized PATH of ~100 markers (no single object pose), so the demonstration choice is SELECT-only (re-run and correct a real failed episode) — there is no middle-ground scene to BRIDGE. Consumed by the P4-LLM reasoning + decision components to ground failure analysis. Coordinates are world-frame metres.

properties.controllable_via: none (arena-randomized set of ~100 markers along a path)

properties.role: maintain downward contact force while sweeping along the dirt path

properties.info: fraction of markers wiped; partial credit signal alongside binary success

reasoning_implications.contact_instability: The pad loses downward contact and skips markers: SELECT a failure where the expert re-demonstrates maintaining wiping pressure along the path.
reasoning_implications.approach_failure: The pad sweeps off the dirt path (misses the remaining-marker centroid): SELECT a failure that re-demonstrates tracking the dirt trail.
reasoning_implications.placement_error: Leaves the last scattered markers uncovered: SELECT a failure re-demonstrating finishing coverage of the tail markers.
reasoning_implications.timeout: Slow/oscillating sweep that runs out of steps before full coverage: SELECT a failure re-demonstrating an efficient continuous sweep.
reasoning_implications.select_only: Wipe randomizes a whole marker PATH, not a single object pose, so BRIDGE is infeasible — always choose SELECT of the most representative failed episode.
reasoning_implications.non_emptiness: A failure IS present, so the decision MUST cite a concrete episode id for SELECT — never refuse.
